title: A cost-effective Co3O4@WO3 hetero-structure derived from WO3@Co-CoPBA for oxygen evolution reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29925-29936
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04599A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhenwei Yan, Zihao Wei, Zhaojun Tan, Shuaihui Guo, Zhipeng Fang, Wen Wang, Gang Li, Xianjie Yuan, Mingqi Tang, Zaiqiang Feng
A simple and novel Co3O4@WO3 hetero-structured heterostructures with cost-effective and high-performance alkaline OER activity was synthesize through hydrothermal synthesis of WO3 on Co-CoPBA precursors coupled with annealing temperature modulation.
